name: xal7070
watch_out_for: Footprint pads reproduce Coilcraft Document 856-1 recommended land pattern: two 1.92 x 6.50 mm pads on 4.82 mm centers (6.74 mm outside span and 2.90 mm inner gap). Courtyard covers the 7.2 ±0.5 x 7.5 ±0.5 mm maximum body plus 0.25 mm clearance. No manufacturer 3D model is vendored. The 15.2 A saturation current is typical and the 13.6 A Irms figure is specified for a 40 C rise, not an application guarantee.
